Package model.users

Class Employee

java.lang.Object
model.users.User
model.users.Employee
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Observer
Direct Known Subclasses:
Admin, Manager, Teacher, TechSupportSpecialist
public abstract class Employee extends User implements Serializable
Abstract class representing any university employee (Teacher, Manager, Admin, TechSupportSpecialist). Extends User and adds employment-specific attributes.
